title: [Master]-ACY amount on Value Entries is recalculated from LCY when the document currency equals the Additional Reporting Currency, causing a mismatch with G/L Entries]
summary: Fixed a calculation error in item journal posting when the document currency matches the additional reporting currency, ensuring ACY amounts on value entries are consistent with G/L entries.
key_points: ACY amount calculations on value entries are now preserved when document currency equals additional reporting currency
Prevents incorrect recalculation of ACY amounts from LCY values during posting
Changes applied across all localization layers
Includes new test coverage for WIP costing with additional currency
